custom_expected:
Step 2: Checking Create and Edit auto-checks View (cascade up).
Step 3-4: Unchecking View also auto-unchecks Create and Edit and Delete (cascade down). View OFF + Create&Edit ON is not a saveable state. Matches Section 6 cascade rules.
custom_preconds: Editing a custom role; Schedule card visible (has all 3 CRUD columns).
custom_steps:
1. In the Schedule card, check the Create and Edit box.
  2. Observe whether View auto-checks.
  3. Try to uncheck View while Create and Edit remains checked.
  4. Observe behavior.
title: View OFF but Create and Edit ON — invalid combination is prevented by UI cascade rules
